# Yellowwood Atelier

> Yellowwood Atelier is a short-term rental (STR) interior design and property brand studio. It designs editorial, photogenic interiors and full property brands for Airbnb properties, boutique hotels, and branded residences — built by operators to drive bookings, higher ADR, and occupancy. It is the design arm of parent company Yellowwood Real Estate; operations hand off to sister brand Yellowwood Properties.

Primary site: https://yellowwoodatelier.com/

## What Yellowwood Atelier does
- Strategic Direction: market analysis, guest profile, and competitive positioning tied to ADR, occupancy, and forced appreciation.
- Editorial Interior Design: refined, photogenic, magazine-quality STR interiors.
- Property Branding: naming, wordmark, identity system, welcome book, signage, and direct-booking site.
- Hospitality Details: welcome basket, playlist, bath products, in-property guide.
- Operations Handoff: transition to Yellowwood Properties for ongoing management.

## Proof / results
- Lazy Lariat (Broken Bow, OK): Airbnb Luxe home; ~$675 ADR (~2x market); 90% first-month occupancy; 5.0 average review.
- Recent work has lifted ADR up to 47% vs. prior pricing and reached 90% first-month occupancy.
